rows.grounds: Gloss 'to-shiva-fire'; compound śiva + agni, dative singular ending -aye.
Gloss 'preceded-by-om'; compound tāra + pūrva, neuter accusative singular -am (adjectival/acc. of respect).
Gloss 'ending-with-svaha'; compound svāhā + anta, neuter accusative singular -am.
Gloss 'consecration'; noun saṃskriyā, feminine nominative singular.
Gloss 'should-be'; optative of √bhū, 3rd person singular active (bhavet).

AMBIGUOUS: Gloss 'in-fire-formed-as-shared-shiva-consciousness'; complex compound with -nale/-anale suggesting agni/anal 'in fire' (loc.sg); membership unclear due to sandhi @nale; form and internal structure uncertain.
